material_findings: Corrected C45 primary-source identifier: UAI 2026 paper is arXiv:2603.24792; prior 2601.13067 was unrelated and is quarantined as a provenance defect.

Small-grid PRM stress-test evidence shows QD archive coverage can improve audit structure without beating equal-budget enumeration/search controls; repair gains cannot be attributed to QD-selected examples at that tested scale.

Noisy-QD evidence supports repeated incumbent questioning and a small reversible cell reservoir; excessive depth consumes exploration budget and D=2 was best on average among D={1,2,4} in the cited benchmark.

Conditional e-process construction demonstrates that adaptively generated model states can be tested anytime-validly when the tested object/rule is frozen before fresh evaluation randomness and conditional e-value validity is established.

Uniform heavy verification can suppress stepping-stone exploration; selective reevaluation plus reversible provisional retention is a stronger controller hypothesis than either one-shot elitism or verify-everything.

termination.exact_next_action: If a clean local-byte path becomes available, run the pinned Loreley independent q_FA/q_FR sweep, then correlated and reversible-provisional variants. Otherwise specify/implement a matched-budget toy QD controller comparing permanent one-shot replacement, small provisional reservoir, and fresh-evaluation e-process promotion; continue primary-source search for adaptive-selection-valid e-values and direct class-conditional archive decision-noise experiments.
